quality_boundary: This Phase 14 inventory verifies Fukui's final-year 2022-2026 eighth comprehensive and implementation plans, annual outcome/KPI reporting route, FY2026 initial budget, and FY2024 settlement. Source-reported KPI classifications remain municipal evidence and are not converted into independent achievement, causal, or comparison conclusions.
